dialogue: A new recruit eh?
Now don't look at me like that. I'm here to aid you.
Now go on, reach the top of the tower and defeat the guardian.
Only that will you pass the test.
...Now, do you have any questions?

The guardian?: The guardian guards the key of the gate.
Get that and you can pass the test.
Your aid?: Yes, I can heal by playing a song.
So no need to worries if you lose.

statements: Very well, off you go then!

dialogue: Have you seen it? The one at the top.
The Gate Keeper.

....But, I have a proposal for you.
What say we join forces? It will speed things up.
alt_dialogue: You have defeated the Gate Keeper?

Very well: You will not regret this decision.

dialogue: ..Ready to work together?

dialogue: Greetings, is there anything you wish to know?

About you: Me? I am from the northern lands.
The Bard: A charming fellow, that's for sure.

dialogue: ..Pardon, but the last fight we had against the Gate Keeper.

...Forgive me, but please allow me to imbue a part of it to myself.
...!! W-What an unstable power. But I feel stronger.
